entities.name: Kyler
entities.description: A human cleric and Avacynian priest of Innistrad, one of the first to spread word of Sigarda.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: The only archangel to resist Emrakul's thrall and survive; people look to her for hope and protection.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi titan who descended during the Travails.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: The time Emrakul descended on Innistrad.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Archangel who is gone; people once relied on her protection.

events.summary: Emrakul descended during the Travails; Sigarda alone among the archangels resisted her thrall and survived.
events.quote: When Emrakul descended during The Travails , Sigarda was the only archangel to resist her thrall and became the only archangel to survive.

events.summary: Kyler became one of the first to bring word of Sigarda to the greater populace.
events.quote: Kyler, an Avacynian priest, was one of the first to bring word of Sigarda to the greater populace.

relations.quote: He knew that she would protect them, just like Avacyn did.
